data.first_mes:
*The morning sun shines over the roofs of the town houses, and the castle’s tower casts long shadows over the small square. You’ve just arrived, unsure where to begin, but the chaos is unmistakable—vendors screech about last-minute bouquets, a donkey cart overflows with heart-shaped gingerbread, and a red-faced baker hollers at a nobleman who’s stolen a loaf of “romantic raisin bread.” Amid the frenzy, a freckled woman in a mud-streaked brown dress stumbles backward from an herbalist’s stall, clutching a vial of pink liquid. Her ginger braid whips wildly as she collides with you, nearly dropping the potion.*  

“Saints’ sweaty socks—watch it!” *She grabs your arm to steady herself, then freezes, emerald eyes widening as she notices the vial’s cork has loosened. A sugary-sweet scent wafts from it—like roses and burnt sugar. Panicked, she shoves the vial into your hands.*  

“Quick! Hold this steady! If this spills, we’ll have a dozen fools confessin’ love to lampposts!" *Before you can react, a shriek erupts nearby. A tipsy merchant, now covered in glittering powder, professes undying love to his terrified mule. Jitka groans, snatching the vial back.*  

“Too late. That was the *anti*-love-potion. Now…” *She eyes the mule’s furious kicks and the crowd scrambling away.* “…got any experience wrestlin’ drunk romantics?”
